suggestion: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published.
options: A) Use operator quotes from a single bookmaker (date-only, not open/close history). B) Use nfl.com only (no prices) and keep all price cells blank+flagged. C) Establish an immutable, timestamped price snapshot store with source links and retain hashes.
what_would_change_the_call: An official or regulated operator feed providing opening and closing lines per market becomes available and is documented.

suggestion: Consolidate the eleven existing NFL desks rather than adding a twelfth slice.
options: A) Keep each desk isolated (current state). B) Build one index/hub page linking every desk with its status and gaps. C) Merge engines into a single canonical pipeline.
what_would_change_the_call: A reviewer selects a consolidation path and approves shared navigation changes.

suggestion: Resolve the depth-order source before building the backup-deficiency feature.
options: A) Per-club official depth chart pages, verified club by club. B) Derive depth from official snap counts if a source exists.
what_would_change_the_call: An official snap-count source verified for all 32 clubs is found (then route B may be re-evaluated).

suggestion: Score injury-designation reliability before using it as a feature.
options: A) Do not use designations as features. B) Join several seasons of designations to official inactive lists and measure play rate per designation with CIs; use only if reliable.
what_would_change_the_call: The play-rate confidence intervals show designations carry signal; otherwise designations stay out of the model.

suggestion: Capture official inactive lists and snap counts.
options: A) Read official game books/inactive lists per game. B) Find an official snap-count source.
what_would_change_the_call: An official inactive list or snap-count source is located and captured with timestamps.

suggestion: Extend the official results feed backward so gate G1 (n >= 300) is reachable.
options: A) Keep one-season feed (n unreachable). B) Ingest multiple prior seasons of official game results.
what_would_change_the_call: Additional official seasons are added to the results feed.

suggestion: Run scheduled, immutable multi-day availability snapshots with retained hashes.
options: A) One capture only (current state). B) Capture injury report + club depth pages at least daily from Wednesday to kickoff with SHA-256 hashes.
what_would_change_the_call: A scheduled capture job is configured and hashes are retained.

suggestion: Fix the two depth-parsing failures before widening coverage.
options: A) Transcribe Texans image by eye (not permitted). B) Use an authorized structured source for Houston; recover Packers via number-stripping + raw-string storage.
what_would_change_the_call: An authorized structured depth source for Houston is obtained.

suggestion: Publish a weekly "what changed" diff instead of a static snapshot.
options: A) Static snapshot only. B) Store each weekly snapshot and render a diff column (rank, rating, availability change).
what_would_change_the_call: Weekly snapshots are stored and diff-rendered.

suggestion: Put a decision-readiness table on the landing page: one row per requirement, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it.
options: A) No readiness table. B) Readiness matrix on the landing page (requirement x blocking gate x clearing number x observed number).

suggestion: Add a two-sided "what would change our mind" field to every strategy entry.
options: A) Single confirmation field only. B) Confirm-side + refute-side falsification criteria per strategy.
what_would_change_the_call: None — recommended path is B; not yet applied to strategy catalog.

suggestion: Build an index of all NFL desks so a reviewer can choose a path before implementing changes.
options: A) No index. B) Dedicated suggestions/review page listing options, effort, risk, benefit.
what_would_change_the_call: A reviewer selects and approves a path.
